title: Waiting for Trade in Markets with Aggregate Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2508.06132v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies learning in markets with aggregate uncertainty about whether trade is efficient. A long-lived seller offers prices to buyers, who are short-lived and arrive according to a Poisson process. A hidden state determines whether the buyers' common value exceeds the seller's reservation value. All parties observe noisy, private signals about the state. With small intertemporal frictions and when the seller has commitment power, the seller waits for a buyer with the most favorable signal to arrive up to an exit time that depends on the seller's private information. This strategy profile maximizes both the seller's profit and the expected surplus. Without commitment, the commitment profit is unattainable. translated_title: 《总体不确定性市场中的等待交易》
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在交易是否有效存在总体不确定性的市场中的学习问题。一个长期存续的卖方向买方报价，买方是短存的，并按照泊松过程到达。一个隐藏状态决定买方的共同价值是否超过卖方的保留价值。所有参与方都会观察到关于该状态的含噪声私人信号。当时际摩擦较小且卖方具有承诺能力时，卖方会等待信号最为有利的买方到来，直至一个取决于卖方私人信息的退出时间。这一策略组合同时最大化了卖方的利润和预期总剩余。在没有承诺的情况下，承诺利润是无法实现的。相反，存在这样一个均衡：卖方同样会等待信号最为有利的买方，但相对于承诺情形，卖方会以低效的方式过晚退出市场，且交易概率也缺乏效率。
tldr: 本文研究了交易有效性存在总体不确定性时市场中的动态学习问题，证明在卖方具有承诺能力且时际摩擦较小时，等待信号最有利买方的策略可同时最大化卖方利润与预期总剩余，而在缺乏承诺时卖方会以低效的方式过晚退出市场。
en_tdlr: This paper studies learning in markets with aggregate uncertainty about trade efficiency, showing that with seller commitment and small intertemporal frictions, waiting for the buyer with the most favorable signal simultaneously maximizes seller profit and expected surplus, while without commitment the seller exits inefficiently late.
